setup: Lie face down on a mat with your legs straight and feet hip-width apart.
Extend your arms fully overhead with your thumbs pointing upward and palms facing each other.
Keep your neck in a neutral position with your gaze directed toward the floor.
steps: Engage your glutes and lower back to smoothly raise your chest, arms, and thighs off the floor simultaneously.
Hold the elevated contraction at the top for a brief pause while keeping your limbs elongated.
Slowly lower your arms, chest, and legs back to the starting position under control.
instructions.breathing: Inhale to prepare, exhale as you raise your limbs into extension, and inhale smoothly as you lower back down.
cues: Think about reaching long rather than just lifting high
Squeeze your glutes to lift the legs
Keep your eyes on the floor to protect your neck

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending the cervical spine by craning the neck upward.
common_faults.correction: Keep your gaze directed at the floor and chin slightly tucked throughout the movement.

common_faults.fault: Bending the knees to lift the feet instead of extending through the hips.
common_faults.correction: Keep your legs straight and focus on lifting the thighs off the floor using your glutes.

common_faults.fault: Using fast, uncontrolled momentum to bounce off the floor.
common_faults.correction: Move smoothly with a controlled tempo and pause briefly at the top of each repetition.

precautions: Individuals with acute lumbar spine pain should limit the range of motion or consult a clinician before performing spinal hyperextension.

name: Superman
summary: A bodyweight exercise performed lying prone where the arms and legs are raised simultaneously to strengthen the posterior chain.
